instruction: Fix the HTTP method handling bug in this Requests checkout. On Python 3 a caller passing a bytes method such as b'GET' has it converted to the literal text b'GET' instead of GET, causing the wrong HTTP method to be sent. Preserve existing text-method behavior and request options. Inspect the repository and implement a compatible fix. Only existing Python files under requests/ will be exported. No network is available; the package imports directly from /workspace. You may write focused local tests using an in-memory transport. Do not modify upstream tests. Submit only after focused checks pass.
